comment: Dev sandbox (devMode, T or Select in the team menu): an arena without obstacles where emitters keep terrain alive, to test terrains and their affinities. Emitters are scenery (no collider, cannot be hit). pokemon: whose sprites they show; offset: their place from the arena centre, in tiles; terrain: key in terrains.json; target: where they paint, from themselves (0,0 = under them); radius in tiles; every: seconds between two refreshes (only the tiles still holding the terrain last longer: a neutralised tile stays so); recast: seconds between two full casts of the zone (15 when omitted); strikes on another patch (a target) are full casts every 'every' seconds; duration: seconds the terrain lasts (longer than every: it never fades); delay: seconds before the first paint. enemyWaves: true sends the first stage's waves on a loop, to see the AIs deal with the terrain (off by default).

emitters.comment: Ring of steady patches, one per terrain
Demo west: a pool that lightning strikes every 6 s (the whole pool turns electrified)
Demo east: a bramble field that fire sets ablaze every 7 s
